name: Inran Quest ~Fiona to Merlin no Ecchi na Tabi~
original_name: 淫乱クエスト～フィオナとメルリンのエッチな旅～
source:
While monsters shame her in battle
and horny villagers throw themselves at her,
Fiona earns money to free herself
from the cursed "power of attraction"...
Can she do it with her dignity intact?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ170712.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
怪物会在战斗中让她蒙羞，好色的村民也会主动向她投怀送抱。菲奥娜为了摆脱诅咒般的“吸引力”而赚钱……她能在保住尊严的同时做到吗？

[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ170712.html/]DLsite英文版[/url]]
